items.title: Jimmy Heath interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, September 8, 2014
items.q: The interviewer introduces himself as 'Monk Rowe'. The interviewee responds 'Thank you very much, Monk.' This indicates a professional or polite acquaintance within the context of the interview, but no deeper personal or musical relationship is described.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at St. Peter’s Church inside the chapel with Mr. Jimmy Heath, composer and arranger, jazz master. I wanted to congratulate you on your career —
